verdict: The accepted version keeps all data and conclusions and adds clarifications rather than new measurements in the main text. The clearest referee-driven changes are a new self-similarity scaling analysis, a supplementary peak-width figure with a Kibble-Zurek exclusion, an explanation of the RDS energy profile, and new Methods details on momentum resolution, fluence and the tr-NRDS pump. The abstract's generality claim was narrowed, but the Discussion was not. The old review's major demands for temperature calibration, photocarrier lifetimes, an independent magnon-phonon coupling and more temperatures or fluences are not visibly met. The new supplement was not available, so some answers may sit there.

inferred_requests.title: Show the tail rise is not a Bragg-peak lineshape change or order-parameter quench
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely questioned the constant-width argument, since Fig. 2C is saturated at the peak top, and asked whether the dynamics could be domain coarsening after a quench. The authors moved the width evidence to a supplementary figure and added a Kibble-Zurek exclusion with a new 2025 reference.

inferred_requests.title: Explain why the RDS energy dependence differs from the RXD resonance
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely noted that the upturn peaks at a different energy from the RXD and lacks its self-absorption dip. The authors added an explanation based on near-surface magnon density, without new data.

inferred_requests.title: Give more quantitative support for magnon-magnon quasi-thermalization
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely found the data-simulation comparison qualitative and asked for stronger evidence of a number-conserving magnon cascade. The authors added a self-similarity and scaling analysis with an exponent close to the inverse-cascade value.

inferred_requests.title: State the momentum resolution of the tr-RDS measurement
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely asked how the APD acceptance compares with the 0.01-0.08 r.l.u. offsets probed. The authors now quote ~5 × 10^-3 r.l.u. in Methods.

inferred_requests.title: Define the fluence and explain the high-fluence behaviour
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely asked how fluence is defined and why the upturn falls at high fluence. The authors added a fluence definition and called the RXD reduction nonlinear near T_N.

inferred_requests.title: Justify comparing tr-NRDS with tr-RDS despite different pump conditions
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely pointed out that the ESRF tr-NRDS used a ps pump at 1 kHz, unlike the fs SwissFEL pump. The authors added an argument that pump duration does not change the resulting state.

inferred_requests.title: Tone down the generality claims
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely objected that one material does not support a framework that generalizes across materials. The abstract was narrowed to antiferromagnetic insulators and antiferromagnetic order; the Discussion was not.

inferred_requests.title: Position tr-RDS against existing magnon probes
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely asked what tr-RDS offers beyond established magnon techniques. The authors added a paragraph contrasting it with inelastic neutron scattering, EELS and Brillouin light scattering.

inferred_requests.title: Explain the asymmetry of the signals about q = 0 and clarify Fig. 3
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely noticed that negative-q signals are systematically larger than positive-q ones, at odds with the claimed symmetry. The caption now attributes this to an error in the q origin, and an inset and guide curves were added.

inferred_requests.title: Do not claim the electronic subsystem was measured
inferred_requests.text: A referee may have noted that no probe of the electronic system or photocarriers was used. The introduction now lists only magnetic and lattice systems.

issue_status.reason: The width argument now cites supplementary Fig. S4 and a Kibble-Zurek exclusion was added, but no strain analysis or ±q test along [h0h] appears in the main text.
No equilibrium temperature calibration appears; the text still relies on the supplementary temperature estimate.
Momentum resolution is now stated and guide curves added, but 'proportional to momentum' and the guide-line plot in Fig. 3i are unchanged.
A scaling analysis now supports number-conserving magnon flow, but the simulation is not recalibrated and Fig. 3j-n are still called 'derived from tr-RDS data'.
The ~59 µeV coupling sentence is unchanged and no independent vertex is given in the main text.
Photocarrier lifetimes are not measured; the electron-thermalization sentence is unchanged, though the intro no longer claims the electronic system is studied.
The polarization argument is unchanged; only the figure number moved to Fig. S18.
An explanation for the spectral difference was added, but no self-absorption calculation or tr-XAS control.
A pump-duration caveat and a dedicated supplementary note on thermal expansion were added; no new reference temperatures in the main text.
Fluence is now defined and the high-fluence behaviour called nonlinear, but the dataset inconsistency is not reconciled in the main text.
The main text still only cites a supplementary note for the incommensurate phase; no trace is shown.
The twin-domain paragraph in Methods is unchanged.
The hot-magnon temperature is supplement-only and cannot be checked; nothing in the main text changes.
No new temperatures, fluences or samples appear.
The abstract is narrowed to antiferromagnetic insulators, but the Discussion keeps 'any gapped magnetic insulators' and the attosecond claim.
A comparison with static magnon probes was added, but not with earlier time-resolved X-ray studies; 'not yet experimentally demonstrated' remains.
The microsecond phonon-dissipation conclusion is unchanged in the Discussion.
The hydrodynamic slowdown sentence is unchanged.
No pump-insensitive background check is shown in the main text.
Methods still give 213 K and 230 K; the supplementary figure cannot be checked.
Supplement-only captions cannot be checked.
Fluence definition, momentum resolution and the RDS momentum choice were added; spot sizes, shot counts and error-bar procedure are still missing.
The Fig. 2 caption now explains the choice of (0.49, 0.01, −0.51); the 0-6 ps simulation window is unexplained.
No clarification of the colour-scale maxima in the main text.
Fig. 4e,f caption does not explain the sign convention or absolute rates.
The spin-model paragraph is unchanged.
Supplementary equations cannot be checked.
Time-resonant wording, the duplicate reference and the affiliation period were fixed; 'Mentink1' became 'Mentinkl'.

unaddressed_major.title: Equilibrium temperature calibration of the thermal versus non-thermal claim
unaddressed_major.why: The authors already had a supplementary temperature estimate below T_N1 and likely pointed to it rather than adding new temperature scans.

unaddressed_major.title: Assumed magnon-phonon coupling constant
unaddressed_major.why: No main-text sentence on the coupling changed; theory detail in the supplement is less often probed by experimental referees.

unaddressed_major.title: Long-lived photocarriers not excluded
unaddressed_major.why: The removal of 'electronic' from the introduction hints the topic came up, while the doublon-lifetime citations were kept as the answer.

unaddressed_major.title: Polarization test does not separate transverse magnons from a Bragg tail
unaddressed_major.why: The polarization argument and its wording are untouched.

unaddressed_major.title: Incommensurate-phase contamination
unaddressed_major.why: A supplementary note already argued against it, and the main text keeps pointing there.

unaddressed_major.title: Single temperature, fluence and sample
unaddressed_major.why: New measurements would be needed; a journal accepting without them suggests a response-letter argument if raised.
